title: The experiments themselves: every model fitted as a record of its table's shape, its settings, every fold's scores and the holdout of the one chosen
request: One experiment record per model fitted, keyed to its table's data card, with no row.
plan: Read the models and final stage records.

findings.defect: The experiments builder read projects by id alone, missed PostgreSQL workspaces and ignored consent.
findings.scenario: The same weaknesses the reviewer found in the service's builds (32.24): a project id in two workspaces merged; db/ rows skipped.
findings.cause: Its own reader, written before the service's.
findings.fix: It reads the service's per-(workspace, project) records, train consent only, its split from the project's one group.

findings.defect: The research campaigns' experiments were not in the M3 set.
findings.scenario: 14 model-selection results on public datasets left out.
findings.fix: campaign_records(): each candidate with its dataset card's shape and the optimization result's holdout for the model kept; split by dataset.

measurements.name: experiments on the backfilled store
measurements.gate: every candidate of every engine project and campaign kept as a record, one dataset or project in one split
measurements.result: about 1,700 candidates from 293 engine projects, and 70 from 14 campaign datasets (train 35, dev 20, sealed 15; 4 with their holdout)
limits: the kinds with their own machine record their candidates in their own shapes and are not read yet

outcome: Every fitted model is a record that says which approach won on which kind of table.
risks: Research campaigns' experiments are not yet included.
